scope.zh: 修复初始化期间提前缓存的旧文档覆盖与后续编辑事件漏发窗口；在读操作内原子取得当前文档快照、安装监听器并创建首次didOpen future；didOpen与didChange共用既有FIFO dispatcher，移除500ms经验性等待。；拒绝已删除或项目已关闭的延迟连接，并在真实VFS删除前取消被删除缓存PSI的原生特性请求。
preserves: LSP4IJ transport, queue observation, cancellation and notification futures
Existing waitForDidOpen return behavior, including returning without waiting when false
Workspace folder I/O outside the document critical section
limitations: Not a claim that all LSP request/editor races are solved
Requests such as codeAction still do not flush pending didChange before dispatch
Native runtime validation and packaged-binary integration are owned by the main task
Existing stop/disconnect versus asynchronous connect lifecycle behavior is preserved; this patch does not claim to close all disposal races
Original intermittent native stat-missing notification is not root-causally closed by this lifecycle fix; ordinary single/two-file and held-server controls did not reproduce it

initialVerification.requiredClassReplacement: All generated LanguageServerWrapper*.class and DocumentContentSynchronizer*.class, not only their outer classes
